title: poa alpina f. brevifolia
intro: Poa alpina f. brevifolia, commonly known as Alpine Fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has shown that it possesses various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Poa alpina f. brevifolia are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses and exhibit hepatoprotective properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal activities.
